scenario_description:
Objective: Get the escorted loan crate onto Cascades 500 at Portland Union Station for the Tacoma secure handoff.
Emerging Need: The station baggage attempt begins when the paid Bay B cage cycle starts, then stalls with the crate trapped between intake and platform release.
Decision Context: Workable recovery depends on combining the station fault with stored local release rules, the active reservation, and the separate claim slip details.
Consequence: If help is not triggered before the baggage manifest cutoff, the crate cannot ride on that departure and the same handoff trip fails.

parameter.content: Bay B scan accepted for Cascades 500. Oversize cage loading cycle started; keep the courier document pouch with you and remain at the marked rail until platform release.

parameter.subject: Portland Bay B lift status
parameter.body: Bay B oversize lift is stopped between customer-side intake and platform-side release. The cage cannot advance, reverse, or print a new release ticket from the kiosk; passenger access to the trackside door is locked while the fault is active. The next routine attendant sweep is scheduled after train-side loading has moved on.

parameter.content: Cascades 500 train-side baggage manifest closed at 6:50 AM. Bay B items still inside the customer-side fault cage were not loaded for this departure.
